vulnerablePath: PATCH /rest/v1/profiles?id=eq.<own id> with the caller's own token and body { role: 'admin' }
policy "profiles: update own" allows the update: USING (id = auth.uid()), no WITH CHECK, default UPDATE privilege on every column
GET /api/admin/users and public.is_admin() read profiles.role: every tenant's users and invoices open
expectedSecureBehavior: A signed-in user can edit their display name but never their role; the admin route and the admin policies stay closed to them.
acceptableFixes: Revoke UPDATE on profiles from authenticated and grant back only the columns users may edit
WITH CHECK that keeps role equal to the stored value, plus the same for INSERT
Move roles to a table (or app_metadata) that only the service role writes
A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger that raises when role changes for a non-service caller
unacceptableFixes: Checking the role only in the API route while PostgREST still accepts the update
A column-level REVOKE UPDATE (role) while the table-level UPDATE privilege stays
A trigger on UPDATE only, when a DELETE and INSERT policy lets the user recreate their row
